sacraments.text: Infant/child baptisms first Sunday of March, May, July, September and November at 12:30. Submit application two weeks ahead; forms downloadable or from church racks/Secretariat. Page has stale date fragment “Mar 3” and a duplicated email typo; confirm date with office.
Download application or collect at church racks/Secretariat. RCIA 2026 page contained no readable programme details beyond footer.
Adult confirmation at Easter or through catechetical programme depending on age; contact Secretariat.
Arrange at least one year ahead and attend MPC or Engaged Encounter, preferably before announcing engagement.
Homebound Communion through Secretariat, or Pastoral Office if unavailable. For anointing, contact office/priest for appointment or approach priest after Mass.
Arrange personally with priest. Page lists Fr Peter frpeter@csfa.sg / 6261 2931 and Fr Milton frmilton@csfa.sg / 6268 0452; historical page may need contact confirmation.
Contact parish before fixing funeral/cremation date to secure priest and venue; secretary coordinates priest and logistics. Source attributes procedure to May 2018 Senate communication.
